metadata.database: A Deeper China | Jingdezhen point decision layer

JDZ001.choose_rule: Use before naming museums or studios.
JDZ001.stop_after: The porcelain system is legible as more than an object list.

JDZ002.guest_value: Observe clay, glaze, labour or firing as a connected process.
JDZ002.choose_rule: Use a public route; no private workshop assumed.

JDZ003.guest_value: Read imperial kiln standards and management.

JDZ004.guest_value: Use one innovation question to connect historic and current technique.

JDZ005.guest_value: Observe public art and industrial reuse.
JDZ005.choose_rule: Choose by current programme, not district reputation.
JDZ005.stop_after: One contemporary production question is answered.

JDZ006.choose_rule: No private artist access without consent and release.
JDZ006.stop_after: A public ecosystem layer is clear.

JDZ007.guest_value: Redirect private studio requests to public evidence.
JDZ007.choose_rule: No artist encounter, filming or access promise.
JDZ007.stop_after: The visitor accepts a public alternative.

JDZ008.guest_value: Separate ceramic market observation from collecting and sourcing.
JDZ008.choose_rule: Define personal purchase versus business purpose.

JDZ009.guest_value: Make authentication, valuation, shipping and export limits explicit.
JDZ009.choose_rule: No object guarantee or shipping promise.
JDZ009.stop_after: The visitor knows what remains independently verifiable.

JDZ010.guest_value: Separate a short public workshop from professional learning.
JDZ010.choose_rule: Ask skill, safety, language and delivery needs first.

JDZ011.guest_value: Explain why residency/apprenticeship is not a casual tourism product.
JDZ011.choose_rule: No visa, training or professional-placement promise.

JDZ012.guest_value: Show the evidence required before a making activity can be mentioned.
JDZ012.choose_rule: All partner, safety, language and delivery gates must pass.

JDZ013.guest_value: Make kiln, dust, firing and delivery limits visible.
JDZ013.choose_rule: Use before any making or shipping discussion.
JDZ013.stop_after: The visitor accepts the real production timeline.

JDZ014.guest_value: Give two days a coherent porcelain-system skeleton.
JDZ014.choose_rule: Use one system frame, one public anchor and recovery time.
JDZ014.stop_after: The city is understood without studio-hopping.

JDZ015.guest_value: Use four days for making/artist decisions only when released.
JDZ015.choose_rule: Do not add private access by default.
JDZ015.stop_after: Each day adds a distinct material question.

JDZ016.guest_value: Compare Jingdezhen and Dehua by production question, not prestige.
JDZ016.stop_after: The visitor accepts the transfer and contrast.

JDZ017.guest_value: Pass Shanghai/Hangzhou routing to a separate city decision.
JDZ017.choose_rule: No bundled itinerary or live train promise.
JDZ017.stop_after: The transfer is a conscious choice.

JDZ018.guest_value: Protect payment, language, transport and receiving work.
JDZ018.choose_rule: Build from actual arrival and delivery needs.
JDZ018.stop_after: The visitor can navigate and pay safely.

JDZ019.guest_value: Treat art events and kiln programmes as date-specific.
JDZ019.choose_rule: Only current programme can drive a route.
JDZ019.stop_after: The event fits the dates and question.

JDZ020.guest_value: Observe ceramic labour without intrusive filming or private access.
JDZ020.choose_rule: Public boundaries and consent override the image goal.
JDZ020.stop_after: One public process observation is complete.
